project.name: pydantic
project.description: Data validation using Python type hints. This graph covers only source code at v2.13.0: the pydantic Python package (including the legacy pydantic/v1 copy), the pydantic_core Python bindings and core_schema, and the Rust validation and serialization engine in pydantic-core/src. Tests and docs are excluded.

nodes.name: argument_markers.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the two Python-visible marker types ArgsKwargs (a captured args tuple plus kwargs dict for call validation) and the PydanticUndefinedType singleton sentinel.

nodes.name: ArgsKwargs
nodes.summary: Python class holding positional args and optional kwargs, used as input to call-style validation (arguments and call schemas).

nodes.name: PydanticUndefinedType
nodes.summary: Singleton sentinel type exposed as PydanticUndefined, signalling "no value" distinct from None.

nodes.name: build_tools.rs
nodes.summary: Schema build-time helpers: schema-vs-config lookup functions, the SchemaError Python exception raised for invalid schemas, the ExtraBehavior enum, and a small LazyLock replacement.

nodes.name: schema_or_config
nodes.summary: Looks up a key in the schema dict first and falls back to the config dict, extracting it to the requested type.

nodes.name: schema_or_config_same
nodes.summary: Same as schema_or_config but uses a single key name for both schema and config.

nodes.name: is_strict
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective strict flag from schema, then config.

nodes.name: SchemaError
nodes.summary: Python exception (extends Exception) raised when a core schema is invalid; wraps either a message or a ValidationError with a list of errors.

nodes.name: ExtraBehavior
nodes.summary: Enum of allow/forbid/ignore handling for extra fields, parsed from schema or config.

nodes.name: LazyLock
nodes.summary: Minimal lazily-initialized value wrapper (replacement for std LazyLock on older Rust versions).

nodes.name: union.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Discriminator enum (lookup-path or callable) used by tagged unions in both validators and serializers, with Python GC traversal support.

nodes.name: Discriminator
nodes.summary: Enum describing how a tagged union finds its tag: a lookup path into the value or a callable, with display and GC traversal.

nodes.name: definitions.rs
nodes.summary: Reference/definition management for recursive schemas: DefinitionsBuilder collects named definitions into id-indexed slots, DefinitionRef points at them, and RecursionSafeCache lazily computes values without infinite recursion.

nodes.name: Definitions
nodes.summary: Final immutable map of named definitions (validators or serializers) shared by reference.

nodes.name: DefinitionRef
nodes.summary: Cloneable reference to a definition slot, resolved lazily with access to a cached name.

nodes.name: DefinitionsBuilder
nodes.summary: Collects references and definitions while a schema is built, assigning stable ids and finishing into a Definitions map.

nodes.name: RecursionSafeCache
nodes.summary: Lazily-populated cache that returns a default value when initialization recurses, preventing infinite loops while naming recursive schemas.

nodes.name: validation_exception.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Python-facing ValidationError exception and its PyLineError entries, including conversion from internal ValError, error dict/JSON rendering, pretty formatting with URLs, and cause chaining via ExceptionGroup.

nodes.name: ValidationError
nodes.summary: Python ValidationError exception: holds line errors, title and hide settings; provides errors(), json(), error_count(), pickling and rich string rendering.

nodes.name: PyLineError
nodes.summary: A single validation error with location, error type and input, convertible to dict, JSON and pretty-printed lines.

nodes.name: ValidationErrorSerializer
nodes.summary: Serde Serialize wrapper that writes a ValidationError as a JSON list of line errors.

nodes.name: PyLineErrorSerializer
nodes.summary: Serde Serialize wrapper that writes one PyLineError as a JSON object (type, loc, msg, input, ctx, url).

nodes.name: maybe_add_cause
nodes.summary: Collects user ValueError and AssertionError exceptions from line errors and attaches them as an ExceptionGroup cause (native on 3.11+, backport before) so tracebacks show the underlying failures.

nodes.name: include_url_env
nodes.summary: Decides whether error documentation URLs are included based on the PYDANTIC_ERRORS_INCLUDE_URL environment variable (with the deprecated OMIT_URL variable still honored).

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for pydantic_core: declares the internal modules, re-exports the public Rust types, defines the from_json function and version/build-info helpers, and assembles the _pydantic_core PyO3 module.

nodes.name: from_json
nodes.summary: Python-exposed function parsing JSON bytes or str into Python objects via jiter, with options for inf/nan, string caching and partial parsing.

nodes.name: get_pydantic_core_version
nodes.summary: Returns the pydantic-core version string, normalizing Cargo versions to PEP 440 style.

nodes.name: get_pydantic_version
nodes.summary: Reads the installed pydantic version from the Python package, cached after first lookup.

nodes.name: build_info
nodes.summary: Returns a string describing build profile and flags for diagnostics.

nodes.name: py_gc.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PyGcTraverse trait and impls for common containers, plus the impl_py_gc_traverse! macro, so Rust-held Python references participate in Python garbage collection.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust macro defined before other modules (macro_use) so impl_py_gc_traverse! is available crate-wide.

nodes.name: PyGcTraverse
nodes.summary: Trait for types that visit contained Python object references for the Python cyclic garbage collector; implemented for Py, Vec, maps, Arc, Box and Option.

nodes.name: recursion_guard.rs
nodes.summary: Recursion protection for validation and serialization: RecursionGuard (RAII), RecursionState with depth limits, and RecursionStack for detecting cyclic references by object id and node id.

nodes.name: RecursionGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that registers an object id and node id on creation and releases them on drop, erroring on cycles or excess depth.

nodes.name: RecursionError
nodes.summary: Enum of recursion failure kinds: cyclic reference detected or depth limit exceeded.

nodes.name: ContainsRecursionState
nodes.summary: Trait for contexts that expose a mutable RecursionState to guards.

nodes.name: RecursionState
nodes.summary: Tracks current recursion depth and the set of in-flight object/node pairs for both validation and serialization.

nodes.name: RecursionStack
nodes.summary: Compact stack-like set with small-size optimization used to detect repeated (object, node) pairs.

nodes.name: computed_fields.rs
nodes.summary: Builds and runs serializers for model computed fields, calling the property or method on the model and writing the result into the output map with alias and exclusion handling.

nodes.name: ComputedFields
nodes.summary: Collection of computed field serializers built from the schema computed_fields list.

nodes.name: ComputedField
nodes.summary: One computed property/method with its return serializer, alias and exclusion settings.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Serialization configuration parsed from the schema config: temporal, timedelta, bytes and inf/nan modes (macro-generated enums), the FromConfig trait, and helpers for rendering datetimes, timedeltas and bytes to JSON or Python.

nodes.name: SerializationConfig
nodes.summary: Copyable bundle of temporal, bytes and inf/nan modes extracted from the serialization config.

nodes.name: FromConfig
nodes.summary: Trait for config-driven mode enums that can be parsed from a config dict key.

nodes.name: utf8_py_error
nodes.summary: Builds a Python UnicodeDecodeError-style PyErr for bytes that are not valid UTF-8.

nodes.name: errors.rs
nodes.summary: Serialization error types: the PythonSerializerError bridge to serde errors, PydanticSerializationError and PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue exceptions, and conversions between PyErr and ser::Error.

nodes.name: WrappedSerError
nodes.summary: Newtype letting PyErr convert with ? into a serde ser::Error.

nodes.name: PythonSerializerError
nodes.summary: Error type of the Python JSON serializer, implemented as a ValueError subclass with a message.

nodes.name: PydanticSerializationError
nodes.summary: Public exception raised when serialization fails, carrying a message.

nodes.name: PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue
nodes.summary: Exception raised by serializers when a value does not match the expected type, enabling union fallback and warnings.

nodes.name: se_err_py_err
nodes.summary: Converts a PythonSerializerError back into a PyErr.

nodes.name: extra.rs
nodes.summary: Per-call serialization state: SerializationState, Extra and ExtraOwned (mode, flags, include/exclude, context), SerMode, WarningsMode, CollectWarnings for fallback warnings, and scoped state setters.

nodes.name: SerializationState
nodes.summary: Mutable state threaded through serialization: warnings, recursion state, config, current model/field, check mode, include/exclude and Extra.

nodes.name: IncludeExclude
nodes.summary: Pair of optional include and exclude values passed per call or scoped per field.

nodes.name: Extra
nodes.summary: Global read-only serialization options for one call: mode, flags such as by_alias and exclude_none, context, type lookup and fallback.

nodes.name: SerCheck
nodes.summary: Enum of union branch check levels: none (no check), strict (subclasses rejected) and lax (subclasses allowed).

nodes.name: ExtraOwned
nodes.summary: Owned copy of Extra used by function serializers so state can outlive the borrow.

nodes.name: SerMode
nodes.summary: Enum of serialization modes: Python, Json, or an Other(String) custom mode.

nodes.name: WarningsMode
nodes.summary: Enum controlling serialization warnings: none, warn, or error.

nodes.name: CollectWarnings
nodes.summary: Collects fallback warnings during serialization and emits or raises them at the end.

nodes.name: ScopedSetState
nodes.summary: Generic RAII helper temporarily overriding a field of state and restoring it on drop.

nodes.name: fields.rs
nodes.summary: GeneralFieldsSerializer and SerField, the shared field-map serializer used by models, dataclasses and typed dicts, handling include/exclude filters, aliases, extras, computed fields and exclude_if.

nodes.name: SerField
nodes.summary: Per-field serialization record: key, alias, optional serializer, required flag, by-alias override and exclude_if callable.

nodes.name: FieldsMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting dict shape: simple dict, model with extras, or typed dict allowing extras.

nodes.name: GeneralFieldsSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer shared by models, dataclasses and typed dicts: iterates declared fields, applies filters and aliases, handles extras and computed fields.

nodes.name: filter.rs
nodes.summary: Include/exclude filtering for serialization: SchemaFilter built from schema-level sets, FilterLogic for key or index checks with negative-index mapping, AnyFilter for hash-based call-time filtering, and nested filter merging.

nodes.name: SchemaFilter
nodes.summary: Include/exclude sets built from schema config, with key and index filter checks.

nodes.name: FilterLogic

nodes.name: AnyFilter
nodes.summary: Filter used at call time that accepts arbitrary hashable keys and indices.

nodes.name: map_negative_index
nodes.summary: Maps a negative index to a positive one relative to sequence length, rejecting negatives for unsized iterables.

nodes.name: merge_dicts

nodes.name: infer.rs
nodes.summary: Type-inferring serialization used when no schema serializer applies (any/unknown types): infer_to_python, infer_serialize and infer_json_key dispatch on the runtime ObType for all builtin and stdlib types.

nodes.name: infer_to_python
nodes.summary: Serializes any Python value to a Python object by inferring its type, entry point when no serializer is known.

nodes.name: infer_to_python_known
nodes.summary: Big match on ObType producing python-mode output for each builtin type, including include/exclude and mode-specific conversions.

nodes.name: SerializeInfer
nodes.summary: Serde Serialize adapter that serializes a value through type inference.

nodes.name: infer_serialize
nodes.summary: Serializes any value to a serde serializer by inferring its type.

nodes.name: infer_serialize_known
nodes.summary: Big match on ObType writing JSON-mode output for each supported type through serde.

nodes.name: infer_json_key
nodes.summary: Converts an arbitrary Python dict key to a JSON string key by type inference.

nodes.name: infer_json_key_known

nodes.name: mod.rs

nodes.name: to_json

nodes.name: to_jsonable_python
nodes.summary: Module function converting any Python value into a JSON-compatible Python structure.

nodes.name: ob_type.rs
nodes.summary: Fast runtime type classification: ObTypeLookup caches type pointers to map Python objects to the ObType enum, with exact/subclass checks used by inference and serializers.

nodes.name: ObTypeLookup
nodes.summary: Cache of type pointers and handles used to classify Python objects quickly into ObType values, including lazy lookups for decimal, enum, uuid and pydantic types.

nodes.name: IsType
nodes.summary: Result of a type check: exact match, subclass match or false.

nodes.name: ObType
nodes.summary: Enum of recognized Python object types driving serializer dispatch.

nodes.name: fallback_isinstance
nodes.summary: Slow-path isinstance sweep for subclasses and non-cached types.

nodes.name: polymorphism_trampoline.rs
nodes.summary: PolymorphismTrampoline serializer that detects subclass instances and dispatches to their own __pydantic_serializer__ instead of the declared type serializer.

nodes.name: PolymorphismTrampoline
nodes.summary: Serializer wrapper that sends subclass instances to their own serializer and otherwise defers to the inner serializer.

nodes.name: prebuilt.rs
nodes.summary: PrebuiltSerializer reuses an already built SchemaSerializer found on a class (__pydantic_serializer__) instead of rebuilding it from the schema.

nodes.name: PrebuiltSerializer

nodes.summary: serde Serializer writing JSON with a pluggable formatter, adapted from serde_json with Python-specific number and key handling.

nodes.name: Compound
nodes.summary: State for serializing sequences, maps and structs, tracking whether the first element was written.

nodes.name: MapKeySerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer restricted to producing JSON object keys (strings and numbers stringified).

nodes.name: format_escaped_str_contents
nodes.summary: Writes JSON-escaped string contents using a lookup table of escape characters.

nodes.name: format_escaped_str
nodes.summary: Writes a full quoted and escaped JSON string through a formatter.

nodes.name: shared.rs

nodes.languageNotes: Uses enum_dispatch and a macro-generated CombinedSerializer enum for static dispatch over all type serializers.

nodes.name: BuildSerializer
nodes.summary: Trait for types that build a CombinedSerializer from a schema dict, config and definitions builder.

nodes.name: TypeSerializer
nodes.summary: Core serializer trait: to_python, json_key, serde_serialize, get_name and retry_with_lax_check, dispatched via enum_dispatch.

nodes.name: PydanticSerializer
nodes.summary: Serde Serialize adapter binding a value, a serializer and shared state.

nodes.name: DoSerialize
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting over Python output and serde output so serializers can share logic for strings, maps and fallbacks.

nodes.name: SerializeMap
nodes.summary: Trait for incrementally building a map in either Python or JSON backends.

nodes.name: to_json_bytes
nodes.summary: Serializes a value to JSON bytes with optional indent, ASCII escaping and a size hint.

nodes.name: serialize_to_python
nodes.summary: Creates the Python-output DoSerialize backend.

nodes.name: serialize_to_json
nodes.summary: Creates the JSON (serde) DoSerialize backend for a given serializer.

nodes.name: SerializeToPython
nodes.summary: DoSerialize backend producing Python objects and dicts.

nodes.name: SerializeToJson
nodes.summary: DoSerialize backend writing through a serde Serializer.

nodes.name: SerdeMapSerializer
nodes.summary: SerializeMap implementation wrapping a serde map serializer.

nodes.name: any.rs
nodes.summary: AnySerializer: the schema serializer for the any type, delegating to runtime type inference.

nodes.name: AnySerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for the any schema type, delegating to the inference functions.

nodes.name: bytes.rs
nodes.summary: BytesSerializer: serializes bytes to Python or JSON according to the configured bytes mode (utf8, base64, hex).

nodes.name: BytesSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for bytes values honoring the configured bytes mode.

nodes.name: complex.rs
nodes.summary: ComplexSerializer and complex_to_str: serializes complex numbers to their string form in JSON and keys, passing through in Python mode.

nodes.name: complex_to_str
nodes.summary: Formats a Python complex as its string form (e.g. 1+2j).

nodes.name: dataclass.rs

nodes.summary: Builder for the dataclass-args schema, producing a GeneralFieldsSerializer over dataclass fields.

nodes.name: DataclassSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for dataclass instances, reading fields from the instance and applying the inner field serializer.

nodes.name: datetime_etc.rs
nodes.summary: Temporal serializer helpers: seconds/milliseconds conversions for datetime, date and time, plus a macro generating the datetime, date and time serializers.

nodes.name: datetime_to_seconds
nodes.summary: Converts a datetime to float seconds since the epoch.

nodes.name: time_to_seconds
nodes.summary: Converts a time of day to float seconds.

nodes.name: decimal.rs
nodes.summary: DecimalSerializer: serializes Decimal values as strings in JSON and passes them through in Python mode.

nodes.name: DecimalSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for Decimal values, string in JSON, passthrough in Python mode.

nodes.name: definitions.rs

nodes.name: DefinitionRefSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer that resolves a schema reference lazily and delegates, with a recursion-safe name.

nodes.name: dict.rs
nodes.summary: DictSerializer: serializes dicts with key and value serializers, include/exclude filtering and JSON key conversion.

nodes.name: DictSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for dicts with key and value serializers and per-key filtering.

nodes.name: enum_.rs
nodes.summary: EnumSerializer: serializes Enum members via their value, using an optional inner serializer and falling back to type-inferred output.

nodes.name: EnumSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for Enum members using the member value and optional inner serializer.

nodes.summary: FloatSerializer and serialize_f64: serializes floats honoring the inf/nan mode (constants, null or strings) in JSON.

nodes.name: FloatSerializer
nodes.summary: Serializer for floats handling inf/nan via config.

nodes.name: serialize_f64
nodes.summary: Writes a float via serde, mapping inf/nan according to InfNanMode.

nodes.name: format.rs

nodes.summary: Serializer converting values to str().

nodes.summary: Writes a value as its str() through a DoSerialize backend.

nodes.summary: Builds a function-plain serializer.

nodes.summary: Serializer that calls a user function to produce the output, with fallback serializer and error handling.

nodes.name: FunctionWrapSerializerBuilder
nodes.summary: Builds a function-wrap serializer.

nodes.summary: Serializer that passes the value plus a handler callable to the user function.

nodes.summary: Python-callable handler given to wrap functions to continue with the inner serializer.

nodes.summary: Python object passed to serialization functions exposing mode, include, exclude, flags and context.

nodes.name: on_error
nodes.summary: Handles errors raised by user serialization functions, converting unexpected-value signals into warnings.

nodes.summary: Serializes a value to a Python object for ListSerializer, handling unexpected values with warnings and fallback inference.

nodes.name: ListSerializer.serde_serialize
nodes.summary: Writes a value to a serde serializer for ListSerializer, falling back to inference with a warning on unexpected values.

nodes.summary: Serializer for literal schemas that classifies expected values and optional enum members.

nodes.name: LiteralSerializer.build
nodes.summary: Builds the LiteralSerializer from its core schema dict, resolving any nested serializers.

nodes.name: patch_base_fields
nodes.summary: Context manager that temporarily replaces FieldInfo defaults on stdlib dataclass bases with dataclass fields and restores them afterwards.

nodes.name: _decorators.py
nodes.summary: Core of Pydantic decorator bookkeeping: info containers for validators and serializers, PydanticDescriptorProxy, Decorator and DecoratorInfos collection across the MRO, and signature inspection helpers to decide whether a function takes an info argument.

nodes.name: get_bases
nodes.summary: Returns the base classes of a class or TypedDict.

nodes.name: mro
nodes.summary: Computes a method resolution order from base lists using the C3 algorithm.

nodes.name: mro_for_bases
nodes.summary: Calculates an MRO for a tuple of bases, also covering TypedDict bases.

nodes.name: get_attribute_from_bases
nodes.summary: Looks up an attribute by following the MRO of a class or tuple of bases.

nodes.name: get_attribute_from_base_dicts
nodes.summary: Looks up an attribute in the __dict__ of each class along the MRO.

nodes.name: _decorator_infos_for_class
nodes.summary: Collects DecoratorInfos from a class namespace by unwrapping PydanticDescriptorProxy entries, without recursing into bases.

nodes.name: inspect_validator
nodes.summary: Inspects a validator function's signature to decide whether it accepts the validation info argument.

nodes.name: inspect_field_serializer
nodes.summary: Determines whether a field serializer is an instance method taking info, based on mode and signature.

nodes.name: inspect_annotated_serializer
nodes.summary: Checks whether an Annotated-style serializer function takes an info argument.

nodes.name: inspect_model_serializer
nodes.summary: Checks whether a model serializer function takes an info argument for the given mode.

nodes.name: _serializer_info_arg
nodes.summary: Maps a parameter count to whether a serializer takes info, raising a user error on invalid signatures.

nodes.name: is_instance_method_from_sig
nodes.summary: Guesses whether a function is an instance method from the name of its first parameter.

nodes.name: ensure_classmethod_based_on_signature
nodes.summary: Wraps a function in classmethod when its signature starts with cls.

nodes.name: unwrap_wrapped_function
nodes.summary: Peels off wrappers (partial, partialmethod, staticmethod, classmethod, property) to reach the underlying function.

nodes.name: get_callable_return_type
nodes.summary: Returns the evaluated return annotation of a callable, resolving forward references using the provided namespaces.

nodes.name: count_positional_required_params
nodes.summary: Counts required positional parameters in a signature, used to detect info arguments.

nodes.name: ensure_property
nodes.summary: Wraps a plain function in property unless it is already a property, cached_property or other descriptor.

nodes.name: ValidatorDecoratorInfo
nodes.summary: Container for data captured by the deprecated V1 @validator decorator.

nodes.name: FieldValidatorDecoratorInfo
nodes.summary: Container for data captured by @field_validator: target fields, mode and info-argument flag.

nodes.name: FieldSerializerDecoratorInfo
nodes.summary: Container for data captured by @field_serializer: fields, mode, return type and when_used.

nodes.name: PydanticDescriptorProxy
nodes.summary: Wraps classmethods, staticmethods, properties or functions together with their decorator info so decorators can be discovered later while still behaving as the original descriptor.

nodes.name: Decorator
nodes.summary: Joins a decorated function with its owning class, name, original object and decorator info, with a factory that builds it from a class attribute.

nodes.name: DecoratorInfos
nodes.summary: Per-class mapping of validators, serializers, model validators and computed fields, built by walking bases and class namespace.

nodes.name: _decorators_v1.py
nodes.summary: Adapters that wrap Pydantic V1 style field and root validators into V2 core-compatible callables, inspecting their signatures to pass values, kwargs or both.

nodes.name: make_generic_v1_field_validator
nodes.summary: Adapts a V1 style field validator (value, values, kwargs variants) into a V2 core validator function by inspecting its signature.

nodes.name: make_v1_generic_root_validator
nodes.summary: Wraps a V1 root validator into a V2 before or after model validator function, handling skip_on_failure.

nodes.name: _discriminated_union.py
nodes.summary: Applies a discriminator to a union core schema, converting it into a tagged-union schema by inferring per-choice tag values from Literal fields, with detailed error handling for invalid or missing discriminators.

nodes.name: apply_discriminator
nodes.summary: Entry point that applies a discriminator to a union schema and returns the resulting tagged-union core schema.

nodes.name: _ApplyInferredDiscriminator
nodes.summary: Stateful helper that walks union choices, infers tag values from Literal discriminator fields, handles nullable and definition-ref choices, and builds the tagged-union schema.

nodes.name: _docs_extraction.py
nodes.summary: Extracts attribute docstrings from a class by parsing its source with the ast module (via a NodeVisitor), used when use_attribute_docstrings is enabled.

nodes.name: _extract_source_from_frame
nodes.summary: Retrieves the source lines of the class body from a frame, using inspect and handling missing source.

nodes.name: extract_docstrings_from_cls
nodes.summary: Maps attribute names of a class to their docstrings by parsing the class source with DocstringVisitor.

nodes.name: DocstringVisitor
nodes.summary: ast.NodeVisitor that pairs each assignment or annotated attribute with the string literal that immediately follows it.

nodes.name: _fields.py
nodes.summary: Collects and rebuilds FieldInfo for models and dataclasses from annotations, applying config-driven alias and title generators, protected-namespace checks and default resolution.

nodes.name: pydantic_general_metadata
nodes.summary: Creates a general annotated-types BaseMetadata object holding arbitrary keyword metadata.

nodes.name: _general_metadata_cls
nodes.summary: Lazily builds the general metadata class to avoid importing annotated_types at import time.

nodes.name: _check_protected_namespaces
nodes.summary: Warns or raises when a field name collides with a protected namespace (string prefix or regex) unless a base class already defines it.

nodes.name: _apply_field_title_generator_to_field_info
nodes.summary: Applies a title generator from config or field to set the title of a FieldInfo.

nodes.name: _apply_alias_generator_to_field_info
nodes.summary: Applies an alias generator to a FieldInfo, filling alias, validation_alias and serialization_alias when not set explicitly.

nodes.name: update_field_from_config
nodes.summary: Applies the title generator and alias generator from model config to a FieldInfo.

nodes.name: collect_model_fields
nodes.summary: Collects model fields and class variables from type hints and the namespace, creating FieldInfo objects, validating names, handling defaults, shadowing and generics.

nodes.name: rebuild_model_fields
nodes.summary: Re-evaluates annotations of existing fields (using a namespace resolver) to rebuild FieldInfo once forward references can be resolved.

nodes.name: _recreate_field_info
nodes.summary: Recreates a FieldInfo from its original annotation, substituting typevars and re-evaluating the type, while keeping existing metadata such as the description.

nodes.name: collect_dataclass_fields
nodes.summary: Collects FieldInfo for a Pydantic dataclass from type hints and dataclass field definitions, including inherited fields and kw_only handling.

nodes.name: rebuild_dataclass_fields
nodes.summary: Rebuilds dataclass fields by re-evaluating annotations when types were previously unresolved.

nodes.name: takes_validated_data_argument
nodes.summary: Checks whether a default_factory takes the validated data dict as its single parameter.

nodes.name: resolve_default_value
nodes.summary: Returns a field default from a static default or by calling default_factory (with validated data when accepted).

nodes.name: _forward_ref.py
nodes.summary: Defines PydanticRecursiveRef, a placeholder callable standing in for a recursive forward reference so the typing module can combine it in unions.

nodes.name: PydanticRecursiveRef
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a type_ref string, callable and supporting | so it can act as a recursive forward ref inside typing unions.

nodes.name: _generate_schema.py
nodes.summary: Central schema-generation module: the GenerateSchema class walks Python types, annotations, models, dataclasses, TypedDicts and standard-library types to produce pydantic-core schemas, with helpers to apply validators, defaults and definitions tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large module (nearly 3000 lines) where GenerateSchema dispatches on the type being processed through many _xxx_schema methods.

nodes.name: check_validator_fields_against_field_name
nodes.summary: Returns whether a validator's field list includes a given field name or the wildcard.

nodes.name: check_decorator_fields_exist
nodes.summary: Raises a user error if decorators reference fields that do not exist and check_fields is enabled.

nodes.name: apply_each_item_validators
nodes.summary: Applies each_item style validators recursively to list, set, dict and similar inner schemas.

nodes.name: _extract_json_schema_info_from_field_info
nodes.summary: Builds JSON schema updates (title, description, deprecated, examples) and the json_schema_extra from a FieldInfo or ComputedFieldInfo.

nodes.name: _add_custom_serialization_from_json_encoders
nodes.summary: Adds a serialization schema derived from the first matching entry of the deprecated json_encoders config.

nodes.name: apply_validators
nodes.summary: Wraps a schema with field-level validators, selecting before, after, plain or wrap functions in order.

nodes.name: _validators_require_validate_default
nodes.summary: Returns True when any V1 validator used always=True, which forces default validation.

nodes.name: apply_model_validators
nodes.summary: Applies model validators of a given mode (before, wrap, after) around a model-like core schema.

nodes.name: wrap_default
nodes.summary: Wraps a core schema in a default schema when a field has a default value or factory.

nodes.name: _extract_get_pydantic_json_schema
nodes.summary: Finds __get_pydantic_json_schema__ on a type, falling back to the deprecated __modify_schema__ with a warning.

nodes.name: _inlining_behavior
nodes.summary: Returns whether a definition-ref schema should be inlined, kept, or inlined while preserving discriminator metadata, based on its serialization and metadata.

nodes.name: GenerateSchema
nodes.summary: Main schema generator: converts Python types, annotations, models, dataclasses, TypedDicts, unions, enums, generics and standard-library types into pydantic-core schemas, tracking definitions, namespaces and config.

nodes.name: _Definitions
nodes.summary: Tracks definition references and stored schemas while generating, supporting recursive models and later inlining.

nodes.name: _FieldNameStack
nodes.summary: Small context stack recording the field name currently being processed.

nodes.name: _ModelTypeStack
nodes.summary: Small context stack recording the model type currently being processed.

nodes.name: _generics.py
nodes.summary: Support for generic models: dynamic creation of parametrized submodels, TypeVar substitution in nested types, two-stage generic type caches and recursion guards.

nodes.name: create_generic_submodel
nodes.summary: Dynamically creates a parametrized submodel of a generic BaseModel and registers it in the caller's module when appropriate.

nodes.name: _get_caller_frame_info
nodes.summary: Checks whether the calling function was invoked from module level and returns the caller module name.

nodes.name: iter_contained_typevars
nodes.summary: Recursively yields all TypeVars appearing in a type or its arguments.

nodes.name: get_standard_typevars_map
nodes.summary: Builds a TypeVar to concrete type mapping from a generic alias.

nodes.name: get_model_typevars_map
nodes.summary: Builds a TypeVar to concrete type mapping for a generic BaseModel class.

nodes.name: replace_types
nodes.summary: Recursively substitutes TypeVars in a type according to a mapping, rebuilding generic aliases, unions, Annotated and callables.

nodes.name: map_generic_model_arguments
nodes.summary: Maps the provided arguments of a parametrization to the generic model's type parameters, validating counts and handling defaults.

nodes.name: generic_recursion_self_type
nodes.summary: Context manager that tracks types currently being built to produce recursive self references.

nodes.name: get_cached_generic_type_early
nodes.summary: Fast first-stage cache lookup of a parametrized generic model using a cheap key.

nodes.name: set_cached_generic_type
nodes.summary: Stores a newly built generic type in both early and late caches.

nodes.name: _union_orderings_key
nodes.summary: Builds a key component that distinguishes Union types with the same members in different order.

nodes.name: _early_cache_key
nodes.summary: Builds the low-overhead key for the early generic type cache.

nodes.name: _late_cache_key
nodes.summary: Builds the more precise key for the late generic type cache.

nodes.name: LimitedDict
nodes.summary: Dict subclass that evicts oldest entries beyond a size limit, used to keep recently built generic types alive.

nodes.name: _import_utils.py
nodes.summary: Tiny cached lazy-import helpers returning BaseModel and FieldInfo, used to avoid circular imports.

nodes.name: _internal_dataclass.py
nodes.summary: Defines slots_true, a dataclass kwargs dict enabling slots=True on Python 3.10+ and empty on older versions.

nodes.name: _known_annotated_metadata.py
nodes.summary: Maps known annotated-types and Pydantic constraint metadata (Gt, Le, MinLen, Strict and so on) onto core schema keys or validator functions, and splits annotations into known and unknown groups.

nodes.name: expand_grouped_metadata
nodes.summary: Expands grouped annotated-types metadata (such as Interval, Len) and field infos into individual constraint objects.

nodes.name: _get_at_to_constraint_map
nodes.summary: Returns the mapping from annotated-types classes to core schema constraint names.

nodes.name: apply_known_metadata
nodes.summary: Applies a known annotation (Gt, Le, MinLen, Strict, pattern and so on) to a core schema, either as schema keys or by wrapping with validator functions.

nodes.name: collect_known_metadata
nodes.summary: Splits annotations into known constraint metadata dict and the list of unknown annotations.

nodes.name: check_metadata
nodes.summary: Validates that the given metadata keys are allowed for a source type, raising a TypeError with a consistent message otherwise.

nodes.name: _mock_val_ser.py
nodes.summary: Provides MockCoreSchema and MockValSer placeholders that stand in for validators, serializers and schemas of not fully defined models, dataclasses and type adapters, and retry the real build or raise a helpful error on use.

nodes.name: set_type_adapter_mocks
nodes.summary: Installs mock core schema, validator and serializer on a TypeAdapter pending schema completion.

nodes.name: set_model_mocks
nodes.summary: Installs mock __pydantic_core_schema__, validator and serializer on a model class with a message explaining the missing definitions.

nodes.name: set_dataclass_mocks
nodes.summary: Installs mock validator and serializer on a Pydantic dataclass that is not fully defined.

nodes.name: MockCoreSchema
nodes.summary: Mapping stand-in for a core schema that attempts to rebuild the real schema on access and raises a PydanticUserError when still undefined.

nodes.name: MockValSer
nodes.summary: Stand-in for SchemaValidator or SchemaSerializer that triggers a rebuild on attribute access or raises a helpful error.

nodes.name: _model_construction.py
nodes.summary: Implements ModelMetaclass and the model-building pipeline: namespace inspection, private attribute handling, field collection, hash function setup, core schema, validator and serializer construction, plus deprecated-field descriptors and weakref helpers.

nodes.name: init_private_attributes
nodes.summary: Initializes private attributes of a model instance from their defaults, acting like a BaseModel method.

nodes.name: get_model_post_init
nodes.summary: Returns model_post_init from the namespace or bases, or None.

nodes.name: inspect_namespace
nodes.summary: Scans a model class namespace to build private attributes, validate field annotations, detect ignored types and raise errors for misuse.

nodes.name: set_default_hash_func
nodes.summary: Installs a generated __hash__ on a frozen model when the inherited one is default or stale.

nodes.name: make_hash_func
nodes.summary: Builds a hash function that hashes the model field values from the instance __dict__.

nodes.name: set_model_fields
nodes.summary: Collects model fields and class vars and stores them as __pydantic_fields__ and __class_vars__.

nodes.name: complete_model_class
nodes.summary: Builds the core schema, validator, serializer and signature of a model, falling back to mocks and recording whether it is fully defined.

nodes.name: set_deprecated_descriptors
nodes.summary: Installs descriptors on the class for fields marked deprecated.

nodes.name: build_lenient_weakvaluedict
nodes.summary: Replaces dict values with weakrefs where possible, for storing parent namespaces without leaks.

nodes.name: unpack_lenient_weakvaluedict
nodes.summary: Reverses build_lenient_weakvaluedict, turning weakrefs back into values.

nodes.name: default_ignored_types
nodes.summary: Returns the default tuple of types ignored when collecting fields (functions, properties, classmethods and so on).

nodes.name: ModelMetaclass
nodes.summary: Metaclass of BaseModel that builds model classes: collects bases data, config, fields, decorators, private attributes, generic metadata and schema, and customizes attribute and instance checks.

nodes.name: _DeprecatedFieldDescriptor
nodes.summary: Descriptor that emits a deprecation warning when a deprecated field is read from an instance.

nodes.name: _PydanticWeakRef
nodes.summary: Picklable wrapper around weakref.ref used for stored namespaces.

nodes.name: _namespace_utils.py
nodes.summary: Namespace resolution for evaluating annotations lazily: NsResolver tracks parent and type namespaces, LazyLocalNamespace defers computation, and helpers build function namespaces.

nodes.name: get_module_ns_of
nodes.summary: Returns the namespace dict of the module where an object is defined.

nodes.name: ns_for_function
nodes.summary: Builds global and local namespaces for evaluating annotations of a function, including type params and parent namespace.

nodes.name: LazyLocalNamespace
nodes.summary: Lazily evaluated mapping used as locals when evaluating annotations, computing its content only on demand.

nodes.name: NsResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves the global and local namespaces for annotation evaluation, tracking the types being processed and the parent namespace.

nodes.name: _repr.py
nodes.summary: Representation mixin providing repr, str, pretty and rich-repr support from __repr_args__, plus display_as_type for readable type names.

nodes.name: display_as_type
nodes.summary: Produces a readable string for a type, close to its source definition, handling unions, literals, generics and callables.

nodes.name: Representation
nodes.summary: Mixin that implements __repr__, __str__, __pretty__, __rich_repr__ and repr_args from a __repr_args__ iterator.

nodes.name: _schema_gather.py
nodes.summary: Traverses a core schema to gather definition references and deferred discriminator schemas, supporting the schema cleaning and inlining step after generation.

nodes.name: traverse_definition_ref
nodes.summary: Records a definition-ref schema in the gather context and decides if it can be inlined.

nodes.name: traverse_schema
nodes.summary: Recursively traverses a core schema across all schema types, visiting nested schemas, definitions and metadata.

nodes.name: gather_schemas_for_cleaning
nodes.summary: Traverses the schema and its definitions to produce the references and discriminator schemas required for cleaning.

nodes.name: GatherContext
nodes.summary: Mutable dataclass context used while traversing a core schema, storing collected references and deferred discriminator schemas.

nodes.name: _schema_generation_shared.py
nodes.summary: Shared handler implementations for schema generation: GenerateJsonSchemaHandler for JSON schema hooks and CallbackGetCoreSchemaHandler wrapping an arbitrary function as a core schema handler.

nodes.name: GenerateJsonSchemaHandler
nodes.summary: JSON schema handler that calls the generator for a core schema without automatic ref unwrapping.

nodes.name: CallbackGetCoreSchemaHandler
nodes.summary: Adapts a plain callable plus a GenerateSchema into a GetCoreSchemaHandler, resolving field schemas and definition refs.

nodes.name: _serializers.py
nodes.summary: Provides serialize_sequence_via_list and a map from sequence types to their constructors, used to serialize sequences element by element while skipping omitted items.

nodes.name: serialize_sequence_via_list
nodes.summary: Serializes a sequence by iterating items through the handler, skipping PydanticOmit, and returning a list in JSON mode or the original container type otherwise.

nodes.name: _signature.py
nodes.summary: Builds inspect.Signature objects for models and dataclasses from their fields, handling aliases, defaults, extras and the dataclass default factory sentinel.

nodes.name: _field_name_for_signature
nodes.summary: Chooses the parameter name for a field, preferring a valid alias identifier.

nodes.name: _process_param_defaults
nodes.summary: Rewrites a dataclass parameter whose default is a FieldInfo into a Parameter using the real default or default factory sentinel.

nodes.name: _generate_signature_parameters
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered mapping of Parameter objects for a model or dataclass init signature, handling extras and extra kwargs.

nodes.name: generate_pydantic_signature
nodes.summary: Generates the final inspect.Signature for a model or dataclass init, including var-keyword extras when allowed.

nodes.name: _typing_extra.py
nodes.summary: Typing utilities: predicates for Annotated, ClassVar, Final, None and callables, parent frame namespace capture, and annotation evaluation helpers with eval_type_backport fallbacks and type-hint collection for models and functions.

nodes.name: is_annotated
nodes.summary: Returns whether a value is the Annotated special form.

nodes.name: is_hashable
nodes.summary: Returns whether a value is the Hashable class.

nodes.name: is_callable
nodes.summary: Returns whether a value is Callable, parametrized or not.

nodes.name: is_classvar_annotation
nodes.summary: Returns whether an annotation represents a ClassVar, including string annotations.

nodes.name: is_finalvar
nodes.summary: Returns whether an annotation is Final, parametrized or not.

nodes.name: is_none_type
nodes.summary: Returns whether a value represents None or NoneType in an annotation.

nodes.name: parent_frame_namespace
nodes.summary: Captures the local namespace of the frame that called the model definition, for forward reference resolution.

nodes.name: _type_convert
nodes.summary: Converts None to NoneType and strings to ForwardRef.

nodes.name: safe_get_annotations
nodes.summary: Gets class annotations while tolerating deferred annotation evaluation on newer Python versions.

nodes.name: get_model_type_hints
nodes.summary: Collects raw and evaluated annotations of a model class across its MRO, tracking which were successfully evaluated.

nodes.name: get_cls_type_hints
nodes.summary: Collects evaluated annotations of a class including parent classes.

nodes.name: try_eval_type
nodes.summary: Attempts to evaluate an annotation in the given namespaces, returning the value and whether it succeeded.

nodes.name: eval_type
nodes.summary: Evaluates an annotation, raising on failure.

nodes.name: eval_type_backport
nodes.summary: Wraps typing evaluation with a fallback to the eval_type_backport package for newer syntax on older Pythons.

nodes.name: _eval_type_backport
nodes.summary: Internal evaluation that retries using eval_type_backport after a backport-fixable error.

nodes.name: _eval_type
nodes.summary: Version-specific shim around typing._eval_type handling its differing signatures across Python releases.

nodes.name: get_function_type_hints
nodes.summary: Returns evaluated type hints of a function, including parameters and return value.

nodes.name: _utils.py
nodes.summary: General-purpose internals: ValueItems for include/exclude handling, smart deepcopy, deep_update, unique_list, lenient isinstance helpers, deprecated_instance_property and SafeGetItemProxy.

nodes.name: can_be_positional
nodes.summary: Returns whether a parameter accepts positional arguments.

nodes.name: unique_list
nodes.summary: Deduplicates a list while preserving order, optionally by a name key.

nodes.name: smart_deepcopy
nodes.summary: Returns immutable and empty builtin values as is, deep-copying everything else.

nodes.name: all_identical
nodes.summary: Checks that two iterables contain the same objects pairwise by identity.

nodes.name: ValueItems
nodes.summary: Helper that computes include/exclude item selections for iterables and mappings, supporting nested and wildcard keys.

nodes.name: SafeGetItemProxy
nodes.summary: Proxy redirecting __getitem__ to get with a sentinel default so missing keys do not raise.

nodes.name: deprecated_instance_property
nodes.summary: Descriptor exposing a class method as a property that warns when accessed on an instance.

nodes.name: _validate_call.py
nodes.summary: Implements ValidateCallWrapper, which builds a core schema for a function's arguments and return value and wraps calls with validation, plus helpers that copy function metadata onto the wrapper.

nodes.name: update_wrapper_attributes
nodes.summary: Copies name, qualname, doc and related metadata from a wrapped function onto its wrapper, handling partials and methods.

nodes.name: ValidateCallWrapper
nodes.summary: Callable wrapper built from a function: generates a core schema for its arguments and return, creates the validator and invokes it on each call.

nodes.name: _validators.py
nodes.summary: Validator functions for standard-library types and constraints, loaded lazily: sequences, import strings, regex patterns, IP types, Fraction, numeric and length bounds, decimals, deque, defaultdict and timezones.

nodes.name: sequence_validator
nodes.summary: Validates Sequence types by validating items and rebuilding the original sequence type.

nodes.name: _import_string_logic
nodes.summary: Implements dotted-path import supporting module:attribute syntax with clear import errors.

nodes.name: pattern_str_validator
nodes.summary: Validates a value as a compiled str regex pattern, compiling strings.

nodes.name: pattern_bytes_validator
nodes.summary: Validates a value as a compiled bytes regex pattern, compiling bytes.

nodes.name: ip_v4_network_validator
nodes.summary: Validates input as IPv4Network with default strictness, raising a custom error.

nodes.name: ip_v6_network_validator
nodes.summary: Validates input as IPv6Network with default strictness, raising a custom error.

nodes.name: max_length_validator
nodes.summary: Checks a value's length against a maximum, raising a known max-length error with plural-aware context.

nodes.name: _extract_decimal_digits_info
nodes.summary: Computes total digits and decimal places of a Decimal, treating negative exponents and trailing zeros.

nodes.name: max_digits_validator
nodes.summary: Validates the maximum number of digits of a Decimal.

nodes.name: decimal_places_validator
nodes.summary: Validates the maximum number of decimal places of a Decimal.

nodes.name: get_defaultdict_default_default_factory
nodes.summary: Infers a default factory for a defaultdict from the value type annotation (list, tuple, set, dict, int and so on).

nodes.name: alias_generators.py
nodes.summary: Public alias generator functions to_pascal, to_camel and to_snake that convert field names between naming conventions with regex based splitting.

nodes.summary: Converts a snake_case string to PascalCase.

nodes.name: to_camel
nodes.summary: Converts a snake_case string to camelCase.

nodes.name: to_snake
nodes.summary: Converts PascalCase, camelCase or kebab-case strings to snake_case with regex rules.

nodes.summary: Describes a path of dict keys and list indices into nested input data for use as a validation alias.

nodes.name: AliasChoices
nodes.summary: Holds multiple alias choices to try in order when looking up a field in input data.

nodes.name: AliasGenerator
nodes.summary: Bundles alias, validation_alias and serialization_alias generator callables and applies them to field names.

nodes.name: annotated_handlers.py

nodes.summary: Normalizes integer channel values into an RGBA object with channels scaled to the 0-1 range.

nodes.summary: Converts HSL channel strings to an RGBA via colorsys.hls_to_rgb.

nodes.summary: Scales a 0-1 float channel to an integer 0-255.

nodes.summary: Simple holder for red, green, blue and optional alpha channel values of a color.

nodes.name: Color

nodes.summary: Defines the schema language shared by pydantic's Python side and the Rust engine: about 55 TypedDict schema types (IntSchema, ModelSchema, UnionSchema, ...), the CoreSchema union, CoreSchemaType and ErrorType literals, CoreConfig, the validation/serialization Info protocols, and a snake_case constructor function for each schema, plus deprecated validator helpers.

tour.title: Public API and BaseModel
tour.description: Start at pydantic/__init__.py, which lazily re-exports the public API so that `import pydantic` stays cheap, and at main.py, which defines BaseModel, the class most users touch. A BaseModel looks like a plain Python class with type hints, but all validation and serialization is delegated to a compiled Rust core. The rest of the tour follows what happens from `class User(BaseModel)` down to that core.
tour.languageLesson: Python modules can define `__getattr__` at module level (PEP 562). Pydantic uses it in __init__.py to import names on first access, which keeps import time low.

tour.title: Class Creation and Metaclass
tour.description: BaseModel uses a metaclass defined in _internal/_model_construction.py. When a subclass is created it collects fields, decorators and config, builds a core schema, and installs the validator and serializer on the class. Config handling lives in _internal/_config.py and the public ConfigDict in config.py, so settings like `strict` or `extra` are resolved before any schema is generated.
tour.languageLesson: A metaclass is the class of a class. Its `__new__` runs when a class statement executes, which lets Pydantic inspect annotations and generate the validator at class-definition time rather than at first use.

tour.title: Fields and Decorators
tour.description: FieldInfo in fields.py describes one field: its annotation, default, alias and constraints. _internal/_fields.py collects these from the class namespace, and _internal/_decorators.py gathers `@field_validator`, `@model_validator` and serializer decorators. The functional_validators.py and functional_serializers.py modules provide the public Annotated-style and decorator forms that later become function nodes in the core schema.
tour.languageLesson: `typing.Annotated[int, Field(gt=0)]` attaches runtime metadata to a type hint. Pydantic reads this metadata to build constraints without changing the type itself.

tour.title: Core Schema Generation
tour.description: _internal/_generate_schema.py is the largest bridge in the Python half: it walks type annotations (models, unions, generics, dataclasses, Annotated metadata) and emits a core schema dictionary. Helpers such as _schema_gather.py resolve definitions and recursive references, _known_annotated_metadata.py applies constraints to the right schema, and _discriminated_union.py rewrites tagged unions. This step turns the field information from the previous step into one self-contained description of how to validate and serialize the type.

tour.title: The core_schema Contract
tour.description: pydantic_core/core_schema.py defines the typed dictionaries and constructor functions (model_schema, str_schema, union_schema and so on) that form the contract between Python and Rust. The _pydantic_core.pyi stub and the package __init__ expose SchemaValidator, SchemaSerializer and the error classes that the Rust extension provides. Everything generated in the previous step must conform to this vocabulary, and everything Rust builds in the next steps is keyed off it.
tour.languageLesson: A TypedDict with a `type` literal key acts as a tagged union. Rust reads that tag to decide which validator to construct.

tour.title: Rust Engine Entry and Validator Build
tour.description: lib.rs is the PyO3 extension module that exposes SchemaValidator and the other classes to Python. validators/mod.rs holds the build step that reads the schema `type` tag and constructs the matching validator, with definitions.rs handling recursive and shared references. The model and model_fields validators show the typical result: a tree of validators mirroring the schema.
tour.languageLesson: Rust traits make this design work: each validator type implements a common `Validator` trait, and the build step returns boxed trait objects so a tree of different validators can be called uniformly.

tour.title: Leaf and Combinator Validators
tour.description: Beyond models, the validators directory has one file per schema type: scalars like string.rs and int.rs, containers like list.rs and dict.rs, and combinators such as union.rs, function.rs, chain.rs and with_default.rs. Combinators wrap other validators, which is how Python-defined function validators and union smart mode run inside the Rust tree. validation_state.rs carries per-call state such as strictness and recursion tracking.

tour.title: Serializers
tour.description: The serializer side mirrors the validator side: serializers/mod.rs defines SchemaSerializer and builds a serializer tree from the same core schema, while type_serializers holds per-type implementations. model.rs and fields.rs handle model fields and include/exclude filtering, and infer.rs falls back to type inference for values that do not match the declared schema. Having both sides generated from one schema is what keeps `model_dump` and `model_dump_json` consistent with validation.

tour.title: Input Adapters
tour.description: Validators do not read Python objects or JSON directly. They go through the Input trait in input/input_abstract.rs, implemented for Python objects (input_python.rs), parsed JSON (input_json.rs) and strings (input_string.rs). This lets one validator tree support lax and strict Python mode, JSON mode and string mode, while lookup_key.rs resolves field names and aliases uniformly.

tour.title: Validation Errors
tour.description: Errors are collected rather than raised on the first failure. errors/types.rs enumerates the error kinds, line_error.rs and location.rs describe one failure at one path, and validation_exception.rs turns the collection into the Python ValidationError. On the Python side, pydantic/errors.py defines the user-facing exception classes such as PydanticUserError.

tour.title: TypeAdapter, Dataclasses and RootModel
tour.description: The same schema pipeline serves more than BaseModel. TypeAdapter validates arbitrary types, pydantic.dataclasses and _internal/_dataclasses.py add validation to dataclasses, RootModel wraps a single value, and validate_call_decorator.py validates function arguments. Each reuses _generate_schema.py and ends with a SchemaValidator and SchemaSerializer.

tour.title: JSON Schema Generation
tour.description: json_schema.py walks the same core schema to emit JSON Schema, with separate validation and serialization modes. Because it reads the core schema instead of the Python class, anything that influences validation, including custom types and metadata stored by _core_metadata.py, shows up in the generated JSON Schema.

tour.title: Built-in Types and Networks
tour.description: types.py, networks.py and aliases.py supply constrained types (conint, SecretStr, PositiveInt), URL and email types, and alias helpers. They plug into schema generation through `__get_pydantic_core_schema__` hooks or Annotated metadata, with shared validators in _internal/_validators.py. Rust-backed URL validation comes from pydantic-core/src/url.rs.
tour.languageLesson: A class can customize its schema by defining `__get_pydantic_core_schema__`. This protocol lets third-party types integrate without modifying Pydantic.

tour.title: Plugins, Mocks and Type Checkers
tour.description: The plugin package lets external code wrap SchemaValidator calls: _loader.py discovers entry-point plugins and _schema_validator.py wraps validators with their hooks. _internal/_mock_val_ser.py installs placeholder validators when a model cannot be fully built yet, for example with unresolved forward references. mypy.py adds a type-checker plugin so static analysis understands model fields.

tour.title: Compatibility and Deprecated Layer
tour.description: Version 2 keeps many V1 names working through shims. _migration.py maps removed names to either a moved location or a clear error, while the deprecated package keeps V1-style class_validators, parse helpers and config handling available with warnings. This is why the old top-level modules such as pydantic/class_validators.py still exist.

tour.title: Side Tour: Legacy pydantic.v1
tour.description: pydantic/v1 is a full copy of the Pydantic V1 implementation, kept so users can migrate gradually. It is pure Python: v1/main.py has a BaseModel with its own metaclass, fields.py and validators.py implement coercion in Python, and schema.py builds JSON Schema directly. Comparing it to the Rust-backed flow above shows what V2 moved into the core.
